subject: Error: Models cannot be compared when test='none'

messages.author: 5dc1bbf636836b0f
messages.subject: Error: Models cannot be compared when test='none'
parts:
I compare two outputs from `bfca` objects:

    fit_efa_all = bcfa(efa_model_all, data=D_CMC_wide, bcontrol=list(method="rjparallel"), test='bootstrap')
    fit_efa_modality = bcfa(efa_model_modality, data=D_CMC_wide, bcontrol=list(method="rjparallel"), test='bootstrap') 

But I get an error about the `test` argument, even though it is not set to `none`.

    Error in blavCompare(fit_efa_modality, fit_efa_all) : 
       blavaan ERROR: Models cannot be compared when test='none'

 Am I using the package wrong?

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Error: Models cannot be compared when test='none'
parts:
Jonas,

The test='bootstrap' argument cannot be used with Bayesian models. I will have to add a check for that.

Try it again without the bootstrap argument.

Ed
